Heading: Interlude: Wandering Souls
Text (JP): 夜の環状線を彷徨う無数の魂
Text (EN): Countless souls wandering the expressway at night

Heading: Interlude: Wandering Souls
Text (JP): 時代が変わっても色あせることのない"最速"の称号──
Text (EN): The title of "The Fastest," which never fades even as eras change──

Heading: Interlude: Wandering Souls
Text (JP): エキゾーストサウンドの咆哮 闇を切り裂くヘッドライト 限界まで踏み込まれるアクセル
Text (EN): The roar of exhaust sound, headlights cutting through the dark, the accelerator floored to the absolute limit

Heading: Interlude: Wandering Souls
Text (JP): ──今、環状線に現れた新しい魂
Text (EN): ──Now, a new soul has emerged upon the expressway

Heading: Interlude: Wandering Souls
Text (JP): 何者でもなかったその魂も ここに足を踏み入れた瞬間から
Text (EN): That soul, who was once nobody, from the instant they set foot here

Heading: Interlude: Wandering Souls
Text (JP): 走りの本能に目覚める
Text (EN): Awakens to the raw instinct of the race

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): 初めての勝利。その高揚感に包まれながらPAの夜風を浴びていると、見知らぬ人物が現れた。自信に満ちあふれ、堂々とした振る舞いが印象的な、活発そうな女だ。
Text (EN): Your first victory. While basking in the excitement and enjoying the night breeze at the parking area, a stranger appeared. A confident, strikingly poised, and lively woman.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): こんばんは、いい夜ね。アンタ……首都環状は初めて？へえ、なかなかやるじゃない！
Text (EN): Good evening. Nice night, isn't it? Is this your first time on the Shuto Expressway? Well, not bad at all!

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): ……って、自己紹介がまだだったわね。私、この辺りじゃ名の通った走り屋なの。１２時過ぎのシンデレラ……なんて呼ばれてるわ。
Text (EN): ...Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet. Around here, I'm known as a prominent street racer. They call me 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): 実は、さっきのバトルを見てたんだけど……アンタがどんなヤツなのか、直接話してみたくなっちゃったのよね〜。で……こうしてPAまで追いかけさせてもらったってワケ。
Text (EN): I actually watched your battle earlier... and it made me want to meet you in person. So, I chased you all the way to this parking area.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): アンタの走り、正直まだまだ粗削りだと思うわ。だけど、他の人にはない“煌き”がある……。
Text (EN): Your driving, to be honest, is still quite raw. But you have a certain "sparkle" others lack.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): ……私ね、走り屋同士のバトルって、一種のコミュニケーションだと思ってるの。
Text (EN): I believe that battles between street racers are a form of communication.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): アンタはここで、これから多くの走り屋たちと出会う。何十、何百というバトルを経験する中で……誰に出会い、何を感じて、どこまで行けるんだろう？ねえ、とってもワクワクすると思わない？
Text (EN): You'll meet many street racers here. Through dozens, even hundreds of battles... who will you meet, what will you feel, and how far can you go? Don't you think it's thrilling?

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): ──「何のために走るのか？」これは、走り屋みんなが胸に秘めてる問いよ。
Text (EN): "Why do we race?" That's the question every street racer keeps deep in their heart.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): アンタがその“答え”を見つけた時……コースの上で聞かせて欲しいの。──バトルを通じて、ね。その時は……容赦しないから！
Text (EN): When you find that "answer," I want to hear it on the course. ---- Through a battle, of course. And when that time comes... I won't hold back!

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): 走り屋の女──12時過ぎのシンデレラはそう言い残すと、身を翻して自らのマシンに乗り込んだ。夜目にも鮮やかな黄色のマシンが、夜の首都環状を切り裂くように、軽やかに駆けていく。
Text (EN): The woman, a street racer---- 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】, said those words and turned to climb into her machine. A vibrant yellow car, even striking in the night, effortlessly sliced through the Shuto Expressway as it sped away.

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): 何のために走るのか──。
Text (EN): "Why do I race?"

Heading: First Victory
Text (JP): 自分の胸に問いかけたとき、この首都環状に巣食う“魔物”の息遣いが聞こえたような気がした。
Text (EN): As you ask yourself that question, it almost feels like you can hear the breath of "the demon" that haunts this Shuto Expressway.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): バトルを終えてPAで一息ついていると、２台のAE86が連れ立ってPAに入って来た。2人の男がマシンから降りて、こちらに話しかけてくる。
Text (EN): After finishing the battle and taking a breather at the parking area, two AE86s entered together. Two men stepped out of their machines and started speaking to you.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): よぉ、さっきバトルした走り屋だな。俺たちは<ROLLING GUY>。見ての通り、ハチロク乗りのチームをやってる。首都環状でも長くやってるからな。そこそこ名が売れているんだぜ。
Text (EN): Hey, you're the street racer from that battle earlier, right? We're 《ROLLING GUY》. As you can see, we're a team of AE86 drivers. We've been around on the Shuto Expressway for a long time, so we've made a bit of a name for ourselves.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): ……いや、名前だけじゃねぇ。今では実力もついてきているはずだ。新しい走り屋たちの踏み台になるのは、もうごめんだ……と思っていたんだがなぁ。
Text (EN): ...No, it's not just a name. By now, we should have the skills to back it up. We thought we were done being stepping stones for new street racers... but here we are.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): ちぇっ、こんなルーキーに負けちまうなんてよー。リーダー、せっかく完璧なマシンに仕上げてたのに、最近またイチから色々いじってるんでしょ？余計なコトせず、そのままにしときゃ良かったんじゃないの？
Text (EN): Damn, losing to a rookie like this... Leader, you went to the trouble of perfecting the car, but you've been tweaking it all over again lately, right? Maybe you should've left it as it was.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): 何言ってやがる、お前もまだまだ“ルーキー”じゃねえか！ったく、一丁前に威勢だけは良くなりやがって。
Text (EN): What are you saying? You're still a "rookie" yourself! Geez, acting all tough all of a sudden.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): いいか、首都環状を走り続けたいなら、“余計なコトせずそのまま”なんて甘い考えは捨てとけ。たとえ一時、頂点を極めたと思ったところで、それに満足してあぐらをかいているようじゃあ、次の瞬間には落ちぶれちまう。　“栄枯盛衰”ってヤツさ。
Text (EN): Listen, if you want to keep running on the Shuto Expressway, throw away any sweet ideas about "leaving things as they are." Even if you think you've reached the top at some point, if you grow complacent, you'll be falling before you know it. That's the "rise and fall" of things.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): いやいや、<ROLLING GUY>が頂点を極めたことなんてないでしょ。“いつも枯れっぱなし”だよ。
Text (EN): No, no, 《ROLLING GUY》 has never reached the top. We've always been on the "withered" side.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): うるせぇ！　「たとえ」だって言ってんだろ！……悪い、話が逸れた。観光客、あんたと話がしたくて声をかけたんだよ。
Text (EN): Shut up! I said it was a "metaphor," didn't I? ...Sorry, I got sidetracked. 【{bad_name}】, I wanted to talk to you, so I called out.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): あんた、いい腕してるぜ。俺たちは不甲斐ないところを見せちまったが……俺の最も尊敬するハチロク乗りが、あんたとバトルしたがってる。
Text (EN): You've got some skills. We may have shown a pitiful display, but... The AE86 driver I respect most wants to battle you.

Heading: The Night the Legend Begins-1
Text (JP): ローリングマスター──。先代のローリング野郎1号を務めていた男さ。
Text (EN): 【ROLLING MASTER】----. He was the predecessor known as 【ROLLING GUY NO. 1】, the title given to the leader of the team 《ROLLING GUY》.

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): 新たな魂の鼓動
Text (EN): The pulsing beat of a new soul

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): 感応し、呼応する古き魂
Text (EN): Old souls that resonate and respond

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): 挑戦者を歓迎する先人と
Text (EN): Predecessors welcoming the challenger,

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): 意思を受け継いでいく挑戦者たち
Text (EN): And challengers carrying forward that will

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): 新旧の魂がふれあい、ぶつかりあい
Text (EN): New and old souls touching, colliding

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): やがて混じりあい、リズムとなる
Text (EN): Gradually mingling into a single rhythm

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): そして紡がれていく
Text (EN): And continuing to weave

Heading: Interlude: Feelings That Transcend Time
Text (JP): 新たな“伝説”――
Text (EN): A brand new "Legend"──

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): PAで休んでいると、どこかで聞いたことのある声で話しかけられた。まるで洋画の吹き替えや、テレビのナレーションのような……美しく張りのある声だ。振り向くと、品の良い衣服に身を包んだ紳士的な男が立っていた。
Text (EN): As you were resting at the parking area, someone spoke to you in a familiar voice. It was like a voice from a foreign movie dub or a TV narrator... beautiful and resonant. Turning around, you saw a gentleman dressed in elegant clothing.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): こんばんは！ ごきげんよう！ また来週！アナタ、観光客さんですよね？ 先ほどはどうもどうも！いやまったく、あれほどの強さをお持ちとは！ ワタクシ、感服いたしました！
Text (EN): Good evening! How are you! See you next week! You're 【{bad_name}】, right? Thank you so much for earlier! Honestly, to possess such strength! I'm absolutely impressed!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): 恭しく一礼しながら、立て板に水とばかりまくしたてる男に少々面食らっていると、その後ろから、背の高い女がおずおずと姿を現した。
Text (EN): As the man bowed politely and spoke fluently without pause, you were a little taken aback. Behind him, a tall woman timidly appeared.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): あの、こんばんは。驚かせちゃってすみません。私、さっきバトルしたトランスドライブです……覚えてますか？
Text (EN): Uh, good evening. Sorry if I startled you. I'm 【TRANCE DRIVE】, from the battle earlier... do you remember me?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): そしてワタクシが、プレイフルジェントルマン……“アチョーギしげる”でございます！一目見たら忘れられない、ハイセンスなマシン！ 紳士的でリッパな出で立ち！ 親の声より聞いた声！以後、お見知りおきを。
Text (EN): And I am 【PLAYFUL GENTLEMAN】... also known as "Achoogi Shigeru"! With my unforgettable, high-sense machine! Gentlemanly and dignified appearance! A voice you'll hear more than your parents'! Please, remember me henceforth.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): ええと……、あなたは久遠のポラリスさんともバトルしたんですよね？私たち、彼女と話してみたいんです。 その……すごく魅力的な走りをする人だから。でも、PAで声をかけても何も話してくれなくって……多分、怖がらせちゃったんだと思うんですが……。
Text (EN): Uh... You've battled 【ETERNAL POLARIS】, right? We'd really like to talk to her. She's... such an amazing driver. But even when we approached her at the parking area, she wouldn't say a word... I think we might have scared her off...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): うーん。 なぜでしょうね？こんなに紳士的なワタクシと、“クルマに乗っていなければ”たいへん奥ゆかしいトランスドライブさん、怖がられるような要素は、全く、これっぽっちもないと思うのですが！ ねえ？
Text (EN): Hmm. I wonder why? With such a gentlemanly person as myself and the incredibly modest 【TRANCE DRIVE】 (when not behind the wheel), there's absolutely no reason for anyone to feel scared! Don't you agree?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): や、やっぱり……私のせいなのかな……？その、私、ハンドルを握ると性格が変わっちゃうタイプで……。バトルの間は無我夢中になって、自分で自分がわからないっていうか……。
Text (EN): C-Could it be... my fault after all? You see, when I take the wheel, my personality completely changes... During battles, I get so absorbed I can't even recognize myself...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): 鬼気迫る、という形容がピッタリですね！ええ、ええ、褒め言葉ですよ、もちろん！
Text (EN): "Terrifying intensity" is the perfect description! Yes, yes, a compliment, of course!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Character (JP): プレイフルジェントルマン
Text (JP): ですがワタクシの見立てでは、久遠のポラリスさんは、そんなヤワな女性じゃありませんよ。“言葉ではなく、走りで語る” ────硬派なタイプなのかもしれません。うーん、しびれますねえ！
Text (EN): But from my observation, 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 doesn't seem like the type to be so easily scared. "She speaks through her driving, not words"----a stoic type, perhaps. Oh, how thrilling!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): 久遠のポラリス────あの日出会った謎の少女。彼女の走りに惹かれる者は、少なくないようだ。
Text (EN): 【ETERNAL POLARIS】---- the mysterious girl you encountered that day. It seems many are captivated by her driving.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The New Generation of Racers
Text (JP): 再び彼女と出会ったその時、言葉を交わすことはできるだろうか──。
Text (EN): When you meet her again, will you be able to exchange words----?

Heading: Interlude: Running Through the Mist
Text (JP): 渦巻く混沌─────
Text (EN): Swirling chaos─────

Heading: Interlude: Running Through the Mist
Text (JP): 答えを求める者たちに 浮かび上がる一つの言葉─────“最速”
Text (EN): To those seeking answers, a single word rises up─────"The Fastest"

Heading: Interlude: Running Through the Mist
Text (JP): 見え隠れするその言葉は 実体はなく霧の中
Text (EN): That flickering word has no substance, lost within the mist

Heading: Interlude: Running Through the Mist
Text (JP): 今はただ走るだけ
Text (EN): Right now, simply running

Heading: Interlude: Running Through the Mist
Text (JP): 今はただそれだけで、心は満たされていく─────
Text (EN): Right now, just with that, the heart is filled─────

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): おい、知ってるか？
Text (EN): Hey, did you know?

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): 最近、停滞気味だった首都環状のバトルシーンに、なんだか動きがありそうだぜっ！
Text (EN): Recently, there seems to be some movement in the stalled battle scene on the Shuto Expressway!

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): ベテランの走り屋たちも、活動が積極的になってるって噂だ。何がきっかけだったんだろうな？
Text (EN): There's a rumor that even veteran street racers are becoming more active. I wonder what triggered it?

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): ああ、その話なら俺も聞いてるよ。
Text (EN): Yeah, I've heard about that too.

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): なんだか、最近になって首都環状に登場した一人の走り屋が、色んな相手に、積極的にバトルを仕掛けているらしいよ。
Text (EN): It seems that a street racer who recently appeared on the Shuto Expressway has been actively challenging various opponents.

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): おおっ、そうだったんだ！で……？　そいつはどんな奴なんだ？速いのか？　ええっ？
Text (EN): Oh, really! So... what kind of guy is he? Is he fast? Huh?

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): 俺だって直接見たわけじゃないから、分からないけど……。他のライバル達が動き出してるってことは、バトルには勝ってるって事だろ？
Text (EN): I don't know, I didn't see it first hand either.... But if other rivals are getting active, it means he's winning battles, right?

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): まぁ、そうだよな……じゃなきゃ、こんな噂にもならないもんな。マジか〜。
Text (EN): Yeah, that's true... otherwise, there wouldn't be such a rumor. Seriously...

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): 突然現れた男が、首都環状のベテラン走り屋たちを次々と撃墜してる……。くぅ〜、カッコいいなぁ！どんな男なんだろうな？　一度、見てみたいよなぁ〜！！
Text (EN): A man who suddenly appeared is taking down veteran street racers on the Shuto Expressway one after another... Man, that's cool! What kind of guy is he? I really want to see him!!

Heading: Rumor 1
Text (JP): 男……とは限らないけどな。
Text (EN): It doesn't have to be a man, though.

Heading: Rumor 2
Text (JP): 裏切りのジャックナイフとブラッドハウンドが立て続けにバトルで敗れたらしい。まさか、かつて“十三鬼将”と呼ばれた走り屋が、2人も撃墜されるとは……。
Text (EN): It seems 【TREACHEROUS JACKKNIFE】 and 【BLOODHOUND】 have both lost in succession. To think that two street racers who were once part of the "THIRTEEN DEVILS" would be taken down...

Heading: Rumor 2
Text (JP): あぁ？　まさか“十三鬼将”を知らないのか？伝説の男、迅帝の元に集まった、すげぇ走り屋たちのことさ。
Text (EN): Huh? Don't tell me you don't know the "THIRTEEN DEVILS"? They were incredible street racers who gathered under the legendary 【SWIFT EMPEROR】.

Heading: Rumor 2
Text (JP): あんた、首都環状の歴史を全く知らないみたいだな……。かつての首都環状には、“四天王”や“裏四天王”と呼ばれた強者たちがいたんだ。
Text (EN): You seem to know nothing about the history of the Shuto Expressway... Back then, there were mighty racers called the "Big Four" and the "Hidden Big Four."

Heading: Rumor 2
Text (JP): その並み居る強豪たちを全員打ち破った奴が、次代のTOPとなり……さらにそいつを撃破して、頂点に立ったのが迅帝さ。首都環状はそうやって歴史を紡いできたんだ。
Text (EN): The one who defeated all those formidable opponents became the next top racer... And the one who took them down to claim the pinnacle was 【SWIFT EMPEROR】. That's how the history of the Shuto Expressway has been woven.

Heading: Rumor 2
Text (JP): “歴史”っていうのは“過去”って意味じゃない。迅帝だけじゃなく、“四天王”や“裏四天王”の時代の走り屋たちも、いまだ現役だったりするのさ……。
Text (EN): "History" doesn't just mean "the past." Not only 【SWIFT EMPEROR】, but also street racers from the eras of the "Big Four" and the "Hidden Big Four" are still active today...

Heading: Rumor 2
Text (JP): ほら、紅の悪魔とか12時過ぎのシンデレラとか……。あんたも名前くらいは聞いたことがあるんじゃないか？
Text (EN): For example, 【CRIMSON DEVIL】 or 【CINDERELLA PAST MIDNIGHT】... You've at least heard their names, haven't you?

Heading: Rumor 3
Text (JP): この間、ここを流してたらバトルに遭遇したよ。はっきりとは分からなかったけど……一人は<RED POLLUTION>だったと思う。
Text (EN): The other day, I was cruising around here and encountered a battle. I couldn't see clearly, but... I think one of them was 《RED POLLUTION》.

Heading: Rumor 3
Text (JP): あ、俺もこの間、バトルしてる奴らを見かけたぜ。見たのはC1で……トレノだったから、片方は多分<ROLLING GUY>なんじゃないかと思う。
Text (EN): Oh, I saw some guys battling the other day too. It was on the C1... one of them was in a Trueno, so I think one of them was probably 《ROLLING GUY》.

Heading: Rumor 3
Text (JP): なんか最近は、バトルしてる奴ら、増えたかもな？
Text (EN): Recently, there might be more guys battling, huh?

Heading: Rumor 3
Text (JP): ああ、確かに一時期よりも見かけることが多くなったな。まぁ、四～五年前は、もっと頻繁に見かけてたと思うけどさ。
Text (EN): Yeah, it's definitely more frequent than it was for a while. Well, I think we saw it more often four or five years ago, though.

Heading: Rumor 3
Text (JP): 確かにそうだな。あの頃は、走り屋たちの勢力争いみたいなものが、結構あったからね。ちょっと怖いぐらいバトルしてたもんなぁ～。
Text (EN): That's true. Back then, there was a lot of turf wars among street racers. It was almost scary how much they battled.

Heading: Rumor 3
Text (JP): また、そんな機運が巡ってきてるのかなぁ？
Text (EN): I wonder if that kind of atmosphere is coming around again?

Heading: Rumor 4
Text (JP): やぁ。最近、首都環状の各チームの動向が慌ただしくなってきたと思わないかい？
Text (EN): Hey. Don't you think the movements of each team on the Shuto Expressway have become more hectic recently?

Heading: Rumor 4
Text (JP): 理由はどうやら二つあるようでね、一つは新たな走り屋がデビューしたかと思ったら、連戦連勝。その挙句に金色般若にまで勝ってしまったこと。
Text (EN): It seems there are two reasons. One is that a new street racer debuted and won a series of battles. And eventually defeated 【GOLDEN HANNYA】.

Heading: Rumor 4
Text (JP): まぁこれはビギナーズラックの類だと思うが、負けた方は心穏やかじゃないからね。
Text (EN): Well, I think it's beginner's luck, but those who lost are not at peace.

Heading: Rumor 4
Text (JP): もう一つは、どうやら<Phantom9>が再結成されたらしいってこと、だ。
Text (EN): The other is that it seems 《Phantom9》 has reunited.

Heading: Rumor 4
Text (JP): <Phantom9>ってことは、あの男……スネークアイズが戻って来たことを示している。
Text (EN): 《Phantom9》 means that, that man... 【SNAKE EYES】 has returned.

Heading: Rumor 4
Text (JP): つまり、この後首都環状は、スネークアイズを中心として嵐が吹く。気を付けることだ。
Text (EN): In other words, from now on, the Shuto Expressway will have a storm centered around 【SNAKE EYES】. Be careful.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 5
Text (JP): アタシってば、最近カレに誘われて首都環状に来てみたんだけど、走り屋って、なぁんか“男の世界”みたいなモンだと思ってたワケ。
Text (EN): I was recently invited by my boyfriend to try out the Shuto Expressway, but I thought street racing was kind of a "man's world."

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 5
Text (JP): したらさぁ、結構女子多いじゃん？おねえさまとか、ギャルとか。結構思ってたイメージと違うっていうか～～。
Text (EN): You know, there are actually a lot of girls here, right? Older sister types, gyaru, and so on. It's not really the image I had in mind.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 5
Text (JP): なんかクルマも可愛くデコってあったりするし、見てるだけでもアガる～～！でもやっぱり走りたくなって、カレにアタシも首都環状デビューしたい、って相談中！
Text (EN): Some cars are even cutely decorated, and just looking at them gets me hyped! But I still want to race, so I'm talking with my boyfriend about making my Shuto Expressway debut too!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 6
Text (JP): 最近、PAで見かけるんだけど、すごく若い女のコがいてさ。一見、クルマなんて乗らなそうな華奢なコなんだけど、それが結構バトルで勝ってるらしいんだよ。
Text (EN): Recently, I've seen a very young girl at the parking area. She looks too delicate to be driving a car, but she's apparently winning a lot of battles.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 6
Text (JP): 久遠のポラリスちゃんっていうらしいので、この間、ちょっと声をかけてみたんだけど……。
Text (EN): She's called 【ETERNAL POLARIS】, and I tried talking to her the other day...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Rumor 6
Text (JP): 無口なコなんだろうね……。軽く無視されちゃったよ、はははっ。
Text (EN): She seems to be a quiet girl... She lightly ignored me, haha.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): PAの入り口に目をやると、先ほどバトルしたマシンが入ってくるのが見えた。やがてマシンから降りてきたのは、夜の首都環状でもとびきり目立つ、真っ白なロリィタファッションの女だった。
Text (EN): Looking toward the entrance of the parking area, you spotted the machine from your earlier battle pulling in. Soon, stepping out of the car was a woman wearing striking, pure white Lolita fashion, standing out even on the night-lit Shuto Expressway.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): こんばんは、観光客さん。先ほどは、いいバトルになりましたね。
Text (EN): Good evening, 【{bad_name}】. That was quite the battle earlier, wasn't it?

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): ひょっとしたら、既にご存じかもしれませんが……私は<CUPID ARROWS>のリーダー、幻惑の白き妖精です。
Text (EN): You may already know this, but... I'm 【THE ENCHANTING WHITE FAIRY】, the leader of 《CUPID ARROWS》.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): <CUPID ARROWS>って、首都環状でも歴史の長いチームなんですよ。私も、長い間ここを走ってきて、それなりの経験を積んできたつもりだったんですけどね……。正直……自信をなくしちゃったかもしれません。
Text (EN): 《CUPID ARROWS》 is one of the longest-standing teams on the Shuto Expressway. I've been racing here for quite some time and thought I had gained a fair amount of experience... but honestly... I may have lost my confidence.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): ──あら、あなたらしくないセリフね。そんな弱気な子に<CUPID ARROWS>を預けた覚えはなくってよ。
Text (EN): ----Oh, that's not like you. I don't recall entrusting 《CUPID ARROWS》 to someone so weak-spirited.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): ──ミッドナイトローズ！！
Text (EN): ----【MIDNIGHT ROSE】!!

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): 豪華なドレスを身にまとった、華やかな女────ミッドナイトローズは、優美な微笑みを浮かべてこちらを見る。その表情とは裏腹に、瞳には闘争心の炎が激しく燃えていた。
Text (EN): A glamorous woman dressed in an opulent gown---- ----【MIDNIGHT ROSE】 looked your way with an elegant smile. Yet behind her expression, her eyes burned fiercely with the flames of determination.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-1
Text (JP): そう……あなたが観光客なのね。妹分の仇を取りにきたわ。私の挑戦、受けていただけるわね？
Text (EN): So... you're 【{bad_name}】. I'm here to avenge my junior. You'll accept my challenge, won't you?

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): あら、――うふふ！ おかしいわね。ごめんなさい、幻惑の白き妖精。仇は取れなかったみたい。
Text (EN): Oh,---- *chuckle*! How strange. My apologies, 【THE ENCHANTING WHITE FAIRY】. It seems I couldn't avenge you.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): だけどね、私は一度負けたからって、あなたみたいに進退を考えたりはしなくってよ？だって……、こんなに楽しいこと、やめられるわけがないじゃない！
Text (EN): But you see, I don't reconsider my future just because I lose once, like you. After all... there's no way I could ever give up something this enjoyable!

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): ミッドナイトローズ……。
Text (EN): 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】...

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): といっても、私だって<CUPID ARROWS>を抜けて……立場や走り方は、その時々で自由気ままに変えてきたのだけれどね。
Text (EN): That said, I also left 《CUPID ARROWS》... My roles and racing style have shifted freely over time.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): 今は、お弟子さんを取ろうかな……なんて考えてみたり。――この前は久遠のポラリスちゃんに声をかけたんだけど、断られちゃったわ。
Text (EN): Now, I've been wondering if I should take on a protégé... ---- I even approached 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 the other day, but she turned me down.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): そんな風に弟子を取って、自分の名前を譲った人もいるようだけど……結局その人も走ることをやめられずに、新しい名前で首都環状を走り続けているみたいよ。
Text (EN): There are racers who take on protégés and pass down their name... but in the end, even they couldn't stop racing and are now running the Shuto Expressway under a new name.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): きっと私たち――どこまで行っても“走り屋”なのよ。
Text (EN): I'm sure of it---- we'll always be "street racers" no matter how far we go.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): ……ふふ、そうですね……。本当に、やめられるわけがない。ありがとう……ミッドナイトローズ。
Text (EN): ...Haha, that's true... I really could never stop. Thank you... 【MIDNIGHT ROSE】.

Heading: Beautiful Rose Blooming at Midnight-2
Text (JP): 観光客さん。私、走り続けます。“走り屋”として！またいつか、手合わせをお願いしますね。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】. I will keep racing. As a "street racer"! Let's battle again sometime.

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): PAに戻ると、見覚えのあるマシンが待ち構えていた。“黒崎三兄弟”のうち2人――以前話した金色般若と、先ほどのバトル相手である鉄翁だ。
Text (EN): Returning to the parking area, you found a familiar machine waiting for you. Two of the "Kurosaki Brothers"---- the previously encountered 【GOLDEN HANNYA】 and the opponent from the earlier battle, 【IRON OLD MAN】.

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): チッ、兄貴もやられちまったのかよ。これじゃあ<Phantom9>の連中に顔がたたねぇじゃねぇかよ！
Text (EN): Tch, even my older brother got taken down? We'll lose face with the 《Phantom9》 crew at this rate!

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): ふっ……だが、これ程の手ごわい相手が現れたことは、<Phantom9>にとって歓迎すべきことかもしれないぞ。強敵を徹底的に叩き潰し、己の強さを証明する……いかにもスネークアイズが好みそうなことじゃないか。
Text (EN): Hmph... but perhaps an opponent this formidable is something 《Phantom9》 should welcome. Crushing a strong enemy to prove one's strength---- that's exactly the kind of thing 【SNAKE EYES】 would relish.

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): けっ、雅路といい、兄貴といい、なんでこんな奴にこだわるのかね。
Text (EN): Tsk, Masamichi, my older brother, why are you both so obsessed with someone like this?

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): おい、若造。お前はなかなか見どころがあるよ。だから忠告しておいてやる――
Text (EN): Hey, rookie. You've got some potential. So let me give you a piece of advice----

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): ――これから首都環状に動乱の時代が訪れる。4年前……かつてスネークアイズと<Phantom9>が、幾多のチームを潰した頃のようにな。
Text (EN): ---- The Shuto Expressway is about to enter a time of turmoil. Four years ago... back when 【SNAKE EYES】 and 《Phantom9》 crushed countless teams.

Heading: Looming Dark Clouds
Text (JP): 今回のバトルは遊びみたいなもんだ。ただし……これから先も、俺たちの前を走ろうとするなら、それ相応の覚悟をしておけ。
Text (EN): This battle was just for fun. But... if you plan to keep racing ahead of us, be prepared for what's coming.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): うつむき加減でPAを歩き回り、異様な雰囲気を放つ男――――先ほどバトルした闇天狗を見かけた。闇天狗は、停められている他人のマシンの周囲を不審な態度でうろついており、周囲の走り屋たちからは警戒されている様子だった。
Text (EN): Walking around the parking area with his head down, emitting an odd aura, was the man you battled earlier----【DARK TENGU】. 【DARK TENGU】 was loitering suspiciously around parked machines that belonged to others, and the surrounding street racers seemed wary of him.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): 闇天狗はふと顔を上げ、こちらを見る。するとたちまち青ざめ、裏返った声でわめき始めた。
Text (EN): 【DARK TENGU】 suddenly looked up and saw you. Immediately, he turned pale and began shouting in a trembling voice.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): あっ、おおお、おまえっ！さっきはよくも、生意気にも、この俺を負かしたな。お前のせいで<Phantom9>を……く、く、クビになったら、どうしてくれるんだよぉっ！
Text (EN): H-hey, y-you! How dare you have the nerve to beat me earlier? If I get kicked out of 《Phantom9》 because of you... w-what am I supposed to do?!

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): くそう……こんなことなら、“舐めプ” なんかしなきゃよかった。お前ごとき、潰す手段なんていくらでもあるのに……。
Text (EN): Damn it... If I'd known this would happen, I wouldn't have gone easy on you. I have so many ways to crush someone like you...

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): へ、へ、へへ。なんか文句があるのか？――――お前にいいことを教えてやるよ。[5]
Text (EN): H-he, heh heh. Got a problem? ----Let me teach you something useful.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): “勝つためのルールしか守らない”。走り屋はみんなそうさ、手段なんて選ばない。それが本質なんだ。[6]
Text (EN): "Only follow rules that help you win." That's what all street racers do-they don't care about methods. That's the essence of it.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): スポーツマンシップにかぶれて、“正義”を気取ってる連中もいるが、俺に言わせればァ、滑稽な連中だよォ、本当にィ！
Text (EN): There are those who are obsessed with sportsmanship and act all "righteous," but if you ask me, they're ridiculous! Truly ridiculous!

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): へ、へ、へへ。何が気に入らないんだか、俺の周りを嗅ぎまわってる奴も、いるみたいだけどさ。どいつもこいつも、無様だな。
Text (EN): H-he, heh heh. There are even people snooping around me, unhappy about something, but they're all so pathetic.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): ――――闇天狗の言う通り、走り屋の本質は“勝利”を求めることだけなのだろうか？それとも――――。
Text (EN): ---- Is 【DARK TENGU】 right? Is the essence of a street racer solely the pursuit of "victory"? Or is there----.

Heading: Playing Only By the Rules That Win
Text (JP): ――――違う “答え” があるのか。
Text (EN): ----Another "answer" out there?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): PAでマシンを降りると、2人組の男が駆け寄ってきた。
Text (EN): As you stepped out of your machine at the parking area, a pair of men rushed over to you.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): おーい、観光客。 君、久遠のポラリスとバトルしたんだって？
Text (EN): Hey, 【{bad_name}】. We heard you battled 【ETERNAL POLARIS】?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): そういう面白いことをやるなら、先に言っておいてくれよ。 俺たちも観戦してみたかったな。
Text (EN): If you're doing something exciting like that, let us know beforehand. We'd have loved to watch.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): 驚いた？ 俺たち、一卵性の双子なんだ。 いつか“双子戦法”を君にも披露するからさ。 楽しみにしててくれよな。
Text (EN): Surprised? We're identical twins. One day, we'll show you our "twin strategy." Look forward to it.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): そんなことより、君が知ってる走り屋の話を聞かせてくれよ。 俺たち、他のチームの情報を常にリサーチ中なんだ。 なぜって、ヤバい相手にいたずらを仕掛けて痛い目を見ないように……いや、これが情報戦ってヤツさ。
Text (EN): But more importantly, tell us about the street racers you know. We're always gathering intel on other teams. Why? To avoid messing with dangerous opponents and getting burned... no, that's what we call the art of information warfare.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): <K-uicks>とはもうバトルしたかい？ 軽自動車オンリーのチームなんだけど、とんでもない迫力だから、見ればすぐにわかるよ。 あれだけ手の込んだマシンに仕上げてるのは、軽自動車愛の賜物だろうね。
Text (EN): Have you battled 《K-uicks》 yet? They're a kei car-only team, but they pack a serious punch-you'll recognize them immediately. The amount of care they put into their machines is a testament to their love for kei cars.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): クルマ愛ってことなら、<Roadnauts>も相当なものだよな。 彼ら、まだ高校生だそうだけど、中古のマシンを自分たちの手でイチからレストアしてるんだろ？ 手がかかっている分、思い入れもひとしおだろうね。
Text (EN): Speaking of car love, 《Roadnauts》 are pretty impressive too. I hear they're still in high school, but they restore used cars from scratch themselves. The effort they put in makes their attachment to their cars that much stronger.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): でも俺が一番注目してるのは、やっぱり<CLAN MAKITA>かな？ あそこのリーダー、なんだかシンパシーを感じるんだよな…… マシンのドレスアップもクールだし、オープンカー統一のチームを組むなんて、目の付け所が良いよね。
Text (EN): But the team I'm most interested in is 《CLAN MAKITA》. I feel some kind of connection with their leader... Their car customizations are cool, and forming a team unified by open cars? Great eye for detail.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): ああ、そういう意味だと俺はリーダーの妹さんの方に共感してる。 自由奔放で頼りない兄を持つ身としては、苦労が絶えないからね。
Text (EN): Oh, in that sense, I relate more to the leader's younger sister. As someone with a free-spirited and unreliable older brother, I know the struggle.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: The Shuto Expressway Nights Are Alive
Text (JP): おいおい！ そりゃないだろ、武虎！
Text (EN): Hey, hey! That's out of line, Taketora!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): PAでマシンの調子を確認していると、2人組の男に声をかけられた。
Text (EN): As you were checking your machine's condition at the parking area, two men called out to you.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): 大柄で筋骨隆々とした、いかにもな肉体派の男――シュワシュワストロングと、芸術家肌という雰囲気の、個性的な男――チリツモ戦士。見た目は対照的な2人だが、親しげな様子だ。
Text (EN): A large, muscular man who looks the part----【SHUWA SHUWA STRONG】 and a quirky man with an artistic vibe----【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】. Despite their contrasting appearances, they seemed quite friendly with each other.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): よぉ、あんた観光客だよな。さっきはどうも、いいバトルだったよ。首都環状を愛する者同士のよしみだ、これからも仲良くしてくれ。
Text (EN): Hey, you're 【{bad_name}】, right? Thanks for earlier-that was a great battle. As fellow fans of the Shuto Expressway, let's get along from here on.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Character (JP): シュワシュワストロング
Text (JP): オウッ！お前、炭酸足りてるか？差し入れだ、1本やる。
Text (EN): Ooh! Got enough soda? Here's one for you-on the house.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): アニキ……あんまり炭酸ばっかり飲まねえほうがいいよ、身体に悪いって。あと、声デカいって。久遠のポラリスもビックリしてただろ？
Text (EN): Brother... you shouldn't drink so much soda; it's bad for you. Also, you're way too loud. Even 【ETERNAL POLARIS】 must've been startled.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Character (JP): シュワシュワストロング
Text (JP): オウッ……。
Text (EN): Ooh...

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): 観光客、あんたは何のために走り始めたのか、今度じっくり聞かせてくれよ。
Text (EN): 【{bad_name}】, someday, you'll have to tell me why you started racing.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): 今の首都環状には、自分のやりたいことを叶えるために来てる奴らが大勢集まり始めてる。俺はそういう連中の話を聞かせてもらうのが好きなんだ。
Text (EN): These days, a lot of people are gathering on the Shuto Expressway to chase their dreams. I like listening to their stories.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): ……俺、ガキの頃からずっとモータースポーツが好きだったんだ。結局、今の仕事はラジオMCをやってるんだけどな。でも、やっぱり走りの世界にいたい……だから首都環状は、憧れの場所なんだよ。
Text (EN): ...Ever since I was a kid, I've loved motorsports. In the end, I'm working as a radio MC now, though. But still, I want to stay connected to the world of racing... that's why the Shuto Expressway is a place I've always admired.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): ここを走ってる間は、夢が叶うような気がする。ずっと探していた――本当の自分がいる場所……って感じがするんだ。
Text (EN): While racing here, it feels like my dreams are coming true. Like I've found---- the place where my true self belongs.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Character (JP): シュワシュワストロング
Text (JP): オウッ！チリツモ戦士よ、お前は相変わらず深く考えすぎなトコロがいけねえな。走りたいから走る――飲みたいから飲む――嘘も本当もねえ！
Text (EN): Ooh! 【EVERY-LITTLE-BIT WARRIOR】, you're still overthinking everything too much. Race because you want to race---- drink because you want to drink---- nothing more, nothing less!

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): うん――、いや――、……そうだな、アニキの言う通りだ。ちょっと自分語りをし過ぎたかな、へへっ。
Text (EN): Yeah---- I mean, no---- ...You're right, brother. I guess I got a bit carried away with my story. Hehe.

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): ――首都環状に集い始めた、新たな走り屋たち。まだ見ぬ彼らの求めるものは何なのか。
Text (EN): ....The new street racers who are beginning to gather on the Shuto Expressway. What is it that they seek, those yet unseen?

Subsection: The Rise of the New Generation
Heading: Where Your True Self Belongs
Text (JP): 自分自身の求めるものは、何なのか――。
Text (EN): What am I searching for----?

Heading: Cinderella Past Midnight
